title: Certify the integrated Workforce Command Center
goal: Provide exact-SHA security, full-story E2E, visual/accessibility, parity, resilience, and performance certification for WFC rollout.

out: Replacing hosted evidence with local assumptions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All admin, department manager, finance, worker, vendor, revoked, unauthenticated, cross-department, and cross-org cases pass without skips
Full create-to-payroll workflow survives reload and records audit evidence
No serious/critical accessibility or core responsive defect remains
Exact-field and monetary parity mismatches are zero and failures never become false zeroes
API p95 is at most 1.2 seconds and critical mutations succeed at least 99.5 percent at representative scale
At least 90 percent first-pass completion and 25 percent faster workforce triage versus WFC-002

progress.summary: Blocked until WFC-009 through WFC-020 are integrated on an exact-SHA target.
next_steps: Consume all implementation handoffs and WFC-002 baseline
Run certification and publish a signed pass/fail recommendation
blockers: An isolated exact-SHA environment and protected actors are required

handoffs: QA → Release: exact-SHA certification, defects, performance measurements, and rollout recommendation for WFC-022
resume_condition: Consume all implementation handoffs and WFC-002 baseline
